questions.question:
A cube is made by folding the given sheet. In the cube so formed, what would be the number on the opposite side of the number ‘1'?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/25cbadf096c4980e1cdcc421d483186734ba9bbb0f98a5c553b04f8f73126c8e.png]
questions.solution:
Opposite surface of the open dice can be found by the below method:-

 
• Alternate surfaces are opposite to each other.
 
• No two opposite surface are touched by side or by corners

So, by using the above rule we can find the opposite surface of open dice.

Below are the opposite surfaces:-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/99aa5b7e26324e6595f539fb3f4e918a08fb52ad261775d72a1b0f2594b57e45.png] 

 
 

 
 
**Numbers**

 
 
 
**Opposite**

 
 
 

 
 
**1**

 
 
 
**2**

 
 
 

 
 
3

 
 
 
5

 
 
 

 
 
4

 
 
 
6

 
 
 

 

Hence, **‘2’** is the number on the opposite side of the number ‘1'.

questions.solution:
The opposite sides of the cube are:

E and Z 

X and R

Q and A

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e7598593426606e8359100149affa046bfb1241753ed315a226b2d17b3ad204.png] 

(i) A and Z (When folded, the two sides are adjacent to each other.)

(ii) A and E (When folded, the two sides are adjacent to each other.)

Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing '6'.

questions.solution:
Here, can see that we are given two dices each having one face same i.e. 6. 

We will write the numbers in clockwise direction starting from the common face, then the positional number will be the opposite face of that number.

So,

1st dice: 6 - 5 - 4

2nd dice: 6 - 2 - 3

Also, we can see both the dices have number 6 on the same side and the remaining numbers are shown on both the dices except number 1.

Hence, number __**1**__ will be on the face opposite to the one showing number 6.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8b5b41be328aa61a2fe710d933c8d5822861e300db1b899f16c7395088b9da8.png]
questions.solution:
Here, we have two dice and a common face number 6 on it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5a2076da28b5b56264b4f149a1f6d62f8054a0e26172b4af47529e9925f5c3eb.png] 

So, we will start writing numbers from 6 of the dice in the clockwise direction

1st dice: 6 - 4 - 3

2nd dice: 6 - 5 - 2

As we can see all the numbers are present except number 1, and so number 1 is opposite to number 6.

Hence, the number __**1**__ will be on the face opposite the one showing the number 6.

A cube is made by folding the given sheet. In the cube so formed, which of the following pairs of numbers would be opposite to each other?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/025252b0bef8a87cccbfd826cca74950e7fee2f52513ceaa59948b5b0b04cf1d.png]
questions.solution:
Opposite surface of the open dice can be found by the below method:-

 
• Alternate surfaces are opposite to each other.
 
• No two opposite surface are touched by side or by corners

So, by using the above rule we can find the opposite surface of open dice.

Below are the opposite surfaces:-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/528151647b803d01115ae948f878207daa0f2f40b4cdaba1faa88cf7b84a030a.png] 

 
 

 
 
**Numbers**

 
 
 
**Opposite**

 
 
 

 
 
1

 
 
 
2

 
 
 

 
 
6

 
 
 
5

 
 
 

 
 
3

 
 
 
4

 
 
 

 

**Option (1) 6 and 3 → **No, they are not opposite to each other.

**Option (2) 4 and 5 → **No, they are not opposite to each other.

**Option (3) 3 and 4 → Yes, they are opposite to each other.**

**Option (4) 1 and 6 → **No, they are not opposite to each other.

So, when the table will be constructed, the letters ‘3 and 4’ will be opposite to each other.

Hence, **‘****3 and 4****’** is correct answer
